name: planning
description: Tickets to release: write-ticket (a bug or idea becomes a ticket with acceptance criteria on the tracker page), staging-retest-plan (one living plan, updated in place: new merges added, tested parts removed, results turned into Tested marks), release-pr (the staging → production PR with tickets, migrations, env vars, flags, risks and rollback), artifact-cleanup (propose old or superseded artifacts and leftovers, delete only what you confirm) and delete-tested-designs (designs whose tickets are Tested on staging: rescue what's open, unlink from the tracker, delete on confirmation).
